reviews.comment: 1 security blocker: the /p/<id> proxy server-side-fetches a registrant-controlled entry.url on a LAN-exposed, unauthenticated master (/api/register has no loopback guard, listen binds 0.0.0.0) → SSRF/open-proxy. Fix: restrict proxy targets to loopback. 3 non-blocking (unescaped prefix→XSS, no proxy test, hop-by-hop headers). Spike itself proven: HTML/asset/API/SSE all pass through; SSE streams. 325/325.

fix.comment: Fixed blocker (loopback-only proxy guard, 403 for non-loopback → closes SSRF) + all 3 non-blocking (escape injected prefix; add hermetic proxy test incl. SSRF case; strip hop-by-hop headers) + destroy upstream on client disconnect. 326/326.

reviews.comment: Human approved: reverse-proxy spike + SSRF fix. Stage on dashboard-improvements.
